title: RAG School Assistant
description: This project implements a school-assistant tool using a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline to allow students to query educational content for school subjects. It loads or ingests relevant study material (e.g., documents, notes), creates embeddings, stores / retrieves context and uses a language model to answer questions grounded in that content. The system is built in Python, likely involves document processing (such as PDF/text chunking), semantic search, embeddings and LLM-based answer generation.
